userStories.title: Generate sprint stories for context-matching focus area
userStories.notes: Seed story. Generated 11 stories (US-75-002 through US-75-012) targeting context-matching wire-up gaps. Key finding: MatchScoring.apply_all_adjustments() has title_relevance, description_relevance, tag_keyword_boost, chapter_topic_match, chapter_source_consistency, chapter_coherence_penalty, cross_chapter_relevance, and listicle_consistency adjustments, but TieredMatcher only calls basic adjustments (topic_penalty, broll_boost, caption_quality, timing_penalty, project_boost, consecutive_source_penalty). The advanced adjustments are orphaned code.

userStories.title: Add description keywords to embedding text for enriched semantic search
userStories.notes: Implemented: Added description_enriched_embeddings config flag (default: false) to ContextEnrichmentConfig. Added _extract_description_keywords() method using word frequency with stop word + YouTube word filtering. When enabled, top 5 keywords appended as '[kw1 kw2 ...]' suffix to embedding_text. 10 unit tests pass.
acceptanceCriteria: New config flag matching.context_enrichment.description_enriched_embeddings (default: false)
When enabled, top 3-5 content keywords from video description are appended to embedding_text
Keywords are extracted using simple word frequency (no LLM call needed)
Stop words and YouTube-specific words (subscribe, like, video, channel) are filtered out
Unit test: embedding_text includes description keywords when flag is true
Unit test: embedding_text is unchanged when flag is false (backward compat)

userStories.title: Add gap-specific description-derived queries to iterative match
userStories.notes: Tier: ENHANCEMENT. derive_queries_from_descriptions exists in gap_analyzer.py (~line 927) and is called from iterative_match stage (~line 868), but the current call passes all locked match descriptions as broad queries (priority=1, gap_indices=[]). The function supports gap-specific targeting (scores phrases by relevance to gap text) but the stage doesn't use per-gap description queries. Should call derive_queries_from_descriptions per gap segment for targeted queries. Files: src/stages/iterative_match.py (~line 867-889), src/iterative_match/gap_analyzer.py (derive_queries_from_descriptions ~line 927).
acceptanceCriteria: For each gap segment, derive_queries_from_descriptions is called with that gap's context
Gap-specific description queries have higher priority (2) than broad description queries (1)
Gap-specific queries include gap_indices pointing to the specific gap segment
Broad description queries are still generated as fallback
Unit test: gap-specific query generation returns queries relevant to gap text
Unit test: queries include correct gap_indices and elevated priority
